questions.question_text: What is the maximum age limit for an alumnus to qualify for the Assistantship program?
options: 25 years
28 years
30 years
No specific age limit
questions.explanation: The program stipulates a maximum age of 30 years at the time of application to ensure opportunities for early-career alumni.

questions.question_text: Are students who completed their degree via distance learning eligible for this program?
options: Yes, if the degree is recognized by HEC
No, only on-campus graduates
Only if they visit the campus weekly
Only if they have a research publication
questions.explanation: As long as the degree is verified and recognized by the HEC and earned through Riphah, the mode of study does not disqualify the candidate.

questions.question_text: Which department has the final say on the eligibility of an applicant?
options: The Admissions Office
The Finance Department
The Student Affairs/HR Department
The Security Office
questions.explanation: The Student Affairs or HR department oversees the staffing and placement of assistants.

questions.question_text: Does an alumnus need to be a resident of the city where the Riphah campus is located to apply?
options: Yes, mandatory
No, but must be available for on-campus work
Only if they have a vehicle
No restrictions on residence
questions.explanation: The assistantship involves physical duties; residency is not strictly checked, but availability for on-campus hours is mandatory.

questions.question_text: If an applicant holds a part-time job elsewhere, are they still eligible?
options: Yes, provided it does not conflict with assistantship hours
No, full commitment is required
Only with a salary cap
Only if the job is in the same field
questions.explanation: Applicants may hold outside employment as long as it does not interfere with the assigned duties of the assistantship.

questions.question_text: Which category of students is primarily targeted for the Riphah Alumni Assistantship program?
options: External exchange students
Riphah University graduates pursuing further studies
Faculty members seeking research grants
Non-degree diploma candidates
questions.explanation: The assistantship is specifically designed to support alumni of Riphah International University who are continuing their academic journey within the institution.

questions.question_text: What is the primary academic standing requirement for an applicant to be considered for an alumni assistantship?
options: Top 50% of the graduating class
Clearance of all previous dues with no active academic probation
Completion of at least one research paper
Recommendation from the Dean only
questions.explanation: Candidates must be in good standing with the university, meaning they cannot have outstanding financial dues or active disciplinary/academic probation records.

questions.question_text: Are students currently enrolled in a self-financed program eligible to apply for the assistantship?
options: Yes, provided they meet merit criteria
No, the program is exclusive to scholarship holders
Only if they have part-time employment
Only in their final semester
questions.explanation: The assistantship is open to meritorious students regardless of their fee structure, provided they fulfill the general institutional eligibility criteria.

questions.question_text: What is the minimum required CGPA for an alumnus to be eligible for the Assistantship program?
questions.explanation: The standard academic benchmark for Riphah assistantship programs is typically a 3.00 CGPA to ensure candidates can balance work and academic responsibilities.

questions.question_text: How many years must have passed since graduation for an alumnus to remain eligible?
options: Within 1 year of graduation
Within 2 years of graduation
Within 5 years of graduation
There is no time limit
questions.explanation: The program is designed for recent graduates, usually limiting eligibility to those who have graduated within the last 24 months.

questions.question_text: Can a student who has been subjected to disciplinary action apply for the Alumni Assistantship?
options: Yes, if the CGPA is high
No, disciplinary record is a ground for disqualification
Yes, with a letter of apology
Only after 5 years
questions.explanation: Maintaining a clean disciplinary record is a prerequisite for any official assistantship role at the university.

questions.question_text: Are students currently enrolled in another degree program at Riphah allowed to hold an Alumni Assistantship?
options: Yes, unconditionally
No, it is strictly forbidden
Only if they are in the final semester
Only if approved by the Head of Department
questions.explanation: Concurrent enrollment requires special permission to ensure the assistantship responsibilities do not interfere with academic progress.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a mandatory character requirement for applicants?
options: Must be a university medal winner
Must have a recommendation from an external company
Must exhibit good moral character and conduct
Must have worked in the industry for 1 year
questions.explanation: Professional integrity and good conduct are essential standards for representing the university as an assistant.

questions.question_text: Is the Alumni Assistantship program restricted to Riphah graduates only?
options: No, it is open to all
Yes, it is exclusive to Riphah alumni
Yes, but only for scholarship holders
No, open to graduates of affiliated colleges
questions.explanation: The program is specifically designed to support the Riphah alumni network, hence it is exclusive to Riphah degree holders.

questions.question_text: Are students who have completed their degree through a private status (external) eligible for the Assistantship?
options: Yes, always eligible
No, only regular degree holders are eligible
Only if they have a recommendation from the Dean
Only if they are faculty members
questions.explanation: To maintain academic standards, the program is restricted to candidates who completed their degree as regular students at a Riphah campus.

questions.question_text: Is there a specific requirement for the applicant's conduct during their previous tenure as a student?
options: No conduct requirements exist
Must have a clean disciplinary record
Must have been involved in student government
Must have received a high conduct award
questions.explanation: Candidates must not have any record of disciplinary action or misconduct during their time as a student at the university.

questions.question_text: Can an applicant hold an existing scholarship while applying for the Alumni Assistantship?
options: Yes, provided they disclose it
No, assistantships are not stackable with other financial aid
Only if the scholarship is merit-based
Only if the scholarship is private
questions.explanation: To ensure equitable distribution of financial support, recipients cannot hold multiple university-funded financial assistance programs simultaneously.
